# Generation Genius

> A standards-aligned educational video platform offering K-8 science, math, and ELA lessons with complete lesson plans, hands-on activities, and teacher resources.

Generation Genius partners with the National Science Teaching Association (NSTA) to deliver engaging video-based instruction aligned with Next Generation Science Standards. The platform serves elementary and middle school educators and students across all U.S. states with interactive, game-based learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- K-8 Education
- Standards-Aligned Curriculum
- Science Videos

## Core Products

- [Science Videos for Kids](https://www.generationgenius.com/science-videos-for-kids): Standards-aligned K-8 science video lessons with complete lesson plans and activities
- [Math Videos for Kids](https://www.generationgenius.com/math-videos-for-kids): Standards-based K-8 math video lessons with interactive activities and assessments
- [ELA Videos for Kids](https://www.generationgenius.com/ela-videos-for-kids): K-5 English language arts video lessons covering writing and language skills

## Learning Resources

- [Science Activities for Kids](https://www.generationgenius.com/science-activities-for-kids): DIY science experiments and hands-on activities to complement video lessons

- [Definitions Archive](https://www.generationgenius.com/definitions): Educational glossary and science terminology reference for students and teachers
